Title: Catalogue: one bad file must not take a channel down
Body: A capture that ffprobe cannot read currently fails the whole channel's scan. Skip the file, log one line with its path and reason, and keep the channel alive. Acceptance: a channel folder containing one truncated .mpg still tunes, and the log names the file once.

Title: Banner: fall back to a channel description when the video has no .txt
Body: _build_banner_data() leaves the description line empty when there is no <file>.txt beside the video. Fall back to a channel-level blurb (channel.json `description`), and only then omit the line. Acceptance: a channel with no .txt files shows a blurb on the banner; the bar keeps its 104 px height either way.

Title: CI: run every suite on push
Body: GitHub Actions on windows-latest: Python 3.12, pip install -r requirements.txt, then the six test modules plus scratch/smoke-style offscreen window checks. Qt offscreen needs QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen; no VLC is available on the runner, so stub vlc the way the harness does. Acceptance: a pull request that breaks the timeline tick turns the check red.

Title: Move the screenshot generator into tools/
Body: docs/img/*.png is produced by a throwaway script that lives outside the repository. Move it to tools/shots.py, make it build its own synthetic catalogue, and document it in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md so a contributor can regenerate the README images without touching their real library.

Title: Dayparts: a screen that shows the current window and its pools
Body: The pools work (Morning/Late Night folders, seasonal folders) but nothing on screen says which window a channel is in or which ads it will draw from. Add a panel to the guide or the channel banner listing the active window, its hours, and the next pool change.

Title: settings.json: add a schema version and migrate on load
Body: There is no version field, so renaming a key silently drops a user's setting. Add `schema: 2`, migrate on load, and rewrite the file only when something changed. Acceptance: an old settings.json keeps its clock offset and bindings after the upgrade.

Title: Guide: make the window length configurable up to 3 hours
Body: The guide walks 90 minutes. With 3 hours the columns need to stay readable at 20-character titles — measure before choosing the column count, and keep the NOW line correct at the edges of the range.

Title: Banner: make the hold time a setting
Body: BANNER_HOLD_S is a constant (6 s, 10 s when opened with I). Move it into settings.json next to the 12/24-hour switch so it can be tuned per screen without editing code.

Title: Untrusted durations should be visible, not just logged
Body: probe.py decides whether a duration is trustworthy; when it is not, the guide still draws a normal cell. Mark those cells (a subtle hatch or a tilde before the time) so a wrong-length programme is explained rather than surprising.

Title: Profiles: two people, two catalogues, one CRT
Body: Add `--profile <name>` that switches settings.json, window_state.json and schedule_state.json together under a profile folder. Acceptance: two profiles can hold different catalogues and key bindings without touching each other.

Title: Channel flicking: configurable repeat rate
Body: Holding Up/Down steps through channels at Qt's default repeat, which is too fast on the Aiwa's converter. Expose the repeat delay in settings and apply it in InputController.

Title: Log a tune summary on every join
Body: One line per join: channel, programme, offset into the slot, whether it was a skip. Makes a bad evening diagnosable from the log alone, without a screenshot.

Title: Overlay: document (and probe) the Windows-only path
Body: overlay.py relies on a top-level transparent window pinned over libVLC's child HWND. Write down the technique and its failure modes in docs/, and fail loudly with a readable message when the compositor refuses the window.

Title: Decide the licence
Body: The README currently says all rights reserved. If the intent is preservation and study, MIT or GPL-3.0 is the coherent choice — but it is the author's call, not a default.

Title: Docs: the .txt blurb convention
Body: The banner's description comes from a .txt beside the video; the first line is the blurb and the rest is ignored. That is documented nowhere except one function. Add it to catalog/README.md and to the reading guide.

Title: v0.7.7: channel banner replaces the I card
Body: Bottom bar with channel number, logo, programme title, start/end times, NEXT and a one-line description. Auto-shows after a tune, I toggles it, BACK closes it first, and the watermark fades out while it is up.

Title: v0.7.7: the tick is no longer suppressed by a settling seek
Body: The 1 s timeline tick returned early while _cover_pending was set, so joins drifted later by 1-2 s per item until short ads were entered inside their last second. next_after() also carried a boundary bug. Fixed with TickLoopTests and a 90-minute simulation.

Title: v0.7.6: ad durations are probed instead of assumed
Body: Commercials were scheduled as 30 s regardless of their real length. Durations are now probed and learned while playing, and untrusted values are handled explicitly.
